highest_value_next_test: Independent biological cultures in a common-time cell-model by dose design, paired RNA and calibrated footprints/protein synthesis, with IRE1 and PERK perturbation/rescue.
feasible_but_lower_value: GSE103667 processed bedGraph re-quantification would introduce mm9 reference choices and a 1.5h/1uM context. Its exposed TE direction is already known and it cannot identify the cause in GSE118660. Broader hormonal/human branches remain unfinished.
